title: Connect Git workflows to the 3D-first workspace
description: Make the 3D world a useful primary view of real repository and Git state, with complete synchronized 2D controls for precise operations.
acceptanceCriteria: The world reflects repository hierarchy, active branch, working-tree status, and selection from actual workspace data.
Selection and navigation stay synchronized across 3D, tree, diff, inspector, and status controls.
Core Git operations remain usable through keyboard-accessible 2D controls when WebGL is unavailable.
Scene density, reduced motion, camera recovery, and performance budgets are validated on representative workspaces.

steps.description: Map real Git state into the existing scene model
steps.details: Confirmed workspace branch, working-tree, staged, and unstaged state now updates the existing repository panel title.
Existing tree selection remains shared with 3D selection; 2D conflict recovery uses explicit confirmation and typed server operations.

Added UIKitML/runtime Git status, branch handoff, sync, change, commit, conflict controls, and per-file staged/unstaged visual state with shared typed APIs and confirmation states. bun run typecheck passed, focused Git/API/model coverage passed (36 tests), and bun run build -- --outDir /tmp/github-3d-dist passed. Managed runtime launched, exposed the named spatial controls, and accepted an emulated hand press on action-branch, but remained on the unauthenticated demo fixture. Actual-workspace synchronization, keyboard-only fallback, WebGL-failure, representative-density, and performance evidence remain unavailable.

technicalNotes: Use IWSDK and project-defined skills; do not add a second renderer stack.
Never claim runtime behavior based on source inspection alone.
